تستحون (form X)
# تَسْتَحُونَ (tastaḥūna) /tas.ta.ħuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحَى (istaḥā)
# تُسْتَحَوْنَ (tustaḥawna) /tus.ta.ħaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَحَى (istaḥā)
